objectives: Interpret Pharaoh's dreams and Joseph's counsel.
Explain why Joseph was set over all Egypt.
Explain why Ephraim was set before Manasseh.
takeaways: The sevens were seven years; the dream was doubled because God will surely bring it to pass.
It is not in me: the secret of the Lord is with them that fear Him.
A prudent man foreseeth the evil and prepares; Joseph stored the fifth part in the years of plenty.
He sent a man before them, even Joseph, sold for a servant, and the king made him lord of his house.
Ephraim, the younger, became the head tribe of the Northern Kingdom; Jacob set him before Manasseh.
